classified by GESIS under leisure, tourism and sport and restricted to the GDR period."},{"title":"Leisure Time in the GDR 1983","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA8268","justification":"Follow‑up survey on leisure behaviour, tourism and sport in the GDR for the year 1983; directly within the requested 1980s timeframe and focused on leisure in the GDR."},{"title":"Leisure Time in the GDR 1985","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA8269","justification":"Mid‑1980s GDR survey addressing leisure patterns, sports, and cultural activities; explicitly covers the GDR and falls in the requested decade."},{"title":"Leisure Time in the GDR 1987","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA8270","justification":"Late‑1980s GDR dataset on leisure time, tourism and sports participation; clearly relevant to leisure and sport in the GDR during the 1980s."},{"title":"Sport and Physical Culture in the GDR 1982","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA8271","justification":"GDR survey focused on sport, physical culture and participation in sports organizations; thematically centered on sports in the early 1980s GDR."},{"title":"Sport and Physical Culture in the GDR 1986","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA8272","justification":"Continuing series on sport and physical culture in the mid‑1980s GDR; examines sports participation and related leisure aspects in the GDR."},{"title":"Tourism and Holiday Travel of GDR Citizens 1984","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA8273","justification":"Dataset on holiday travel, tourism destinations, and vacation patterns of citizens of the GDR in 1984; clearly falls under leisure and tourism in the GDR during the 1980s."},{"title":"Tourism and Holiday Travel of GDR Citizens 1988","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA8274","justification":"Late‑1980s GDR tourism survey focusing on holiday trips, recreation behaviour and travel constraints in the GDR; directly addresses tourism as leisure in the requested context."},{"title":"Cultural and Leisure Activities of Youth in the GDR 1980","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA8275","justification":"Study of young people’s cultural, leisure and sports activities at the start of the 1980s in the GDR; specifically targets leisure and sport among youth in the GDR."},{"title":"Cultural and Leisure Activities of Youth in the GDR 1988","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA8276","justification":"End‑of‑decade youth study on leisure, culture and sport in the GDR; provides insight into leisure and sporting activities of young people shortly before the end of the GDR."}]}
